notes: ONE Mamba-1 block on the device, INFERENCE ONLY. Symbol by symbol, as the file's own table gives it: MambaRMSNorm.forward (:494-499) as mamba_rms_norm_kernel / mamba_rms_norm; causal_conv1d_fn, the TORCH FALLBACK (:81-101), as causal_conv1d_fn_kernel / causal_conv1d_fn; mamba_selective_scan, the torch fallback (:174-279); MambaMixer.forward (:359-482) as mamba_mixer_forward; MambaBlock.forward (:514-528) as mamba_block_forward. What is deliberately NOT here: the recurrence itself, because mamba_selective_scan is upstream's FALLBACK for selective_scan_fn and this file keeps that split, calling impl/mamba_ssm/ops/selective_scan_interface.mojo instead; and the four projections, which are gemm.fp32.v1. Everything else in their 1,000-plus-line module -- MambaForCausalLM, the LM head, MambaCache, the training path, MambaModel and every non-Mamba-1 variant -- is out of scope and absent. SEAM OWNERSHIP: S1-S4 (RMSNorm), S12 (the z gate), S13 (the conv tap chain), S14 (softplus), S15 (A = -exp(A_log)), S16 (the residual add) and the four S17 calls; S5-S11 belong to the scan file, which also EMITS the scan.y, skip.out and scan.h stages, so nothing here records them and identity_trace's tag-uniqueness invariant is the loud failure that keeps the split honest. DEVIATION 725: upstream is torch ops over whole tensors, so THERE IS NO UPSTREAM KERNEL DECOMPOSITION TO MIRROR for the elementwise seams; the plan here is one thread per output cell for every seam, and no float crosses a thread boundary anywhere in the file -- no shared memory, no warp primitive, no atomic, no cross-block reduction -- which makes contract clauses 8(b) launch invariance and 8(c) batch-composition invariance properties of the kernel SHAPE rather than of a check that happens to pass. The RMSNorm fold is one thread per token row (contract S1, no block fold) and the conv is one thread per (batch, channel) walking l ascending, which is MAX's causal_conv1d.mojo:188-205 shape and the CUDA causal_conv1d kernel's. DEVIATIONS 726-731 are the file's own; 720, 721 (the conv bias SEED) belong to the oracle and the contract, and 722, 723 to the scan file, cited here and not renumbered || REPLACES-UPSTREAM (was `partial`): this file's own header states the upstream has no counterpart for what it does; see its DEVIATION blocks
